subject: general
question:
Four positions of a dice are given below. Identify the element on the face opposite the face showing A?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/997cf7b37987c7d35a6a896cfe7a2db9cf4cc3bf6c8dbcb7465720a67b9a5f20.png]
solution:
The Alphabet A appears in 3 dice positions i.e. 1st, 3rd and 4th from which it is evident that ‘+, ?, $ and X’ lie adjacent to A. So, the only symbol that is left would be on the opposite face to the face on which number A lies i.e. B.

Hence, B is the correct answer.
